benchmark.reporting_disclaimer: The complete MMLongBench-Doc corpus is a development/reference benchmark used during system selection. It is not a clean holdout, and results must not be described as unseen-test performance.

answer_scoring.comparability_note: Use this pinned v1 protocol for comparison with published MMLongBench-Doc v1 results. Any semantic-judge or corrected-annotation result must be reported separately and must not be compared numerically with v1 scores.

evidence_metrics.definition: For answerable cases, fraction of unique 1-based Gold evidence pages represented by at least one accepted final Evidence item.
evidence_metrics.aggregation: macro mean over answerable cases; also report page-level micro numerator and denominator

evidence_metrics.definition: Fraction of cases whose final Checker state is ready and whose accepted Evidence is sufficient to answer every requested part under review.
evidence_metrics.aggregation: macro mean with answerable and unanswerable slices

evidence_metrics.definition: Fraction of accepted Evidence items judged unsupported, contradicted, or assigned to the wrong question during replay review.
evidence_metrics.aggregation: incorrect accepted items divided by all accepted items; report zero-denominator count

retrieval_metrics.definition: Whether at least one top-1 candidate lies on a Gold evidence page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: macro mean over cases with Gold pages

retrieval_metrics.definition: Whether at least one top-5 candidate lies on a Gold evidence page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: macro mean over cases with Gold pages

retrieval_metrics.definition: Whether at least one top-10 candidate lies on a Gold evidence page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: macro mean over cases with Gold pages

retrieval_metrics.definition: Reciprocal rank of the first candidate on any Gold evidence page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: macro mean over cases with Gold pages; missing hit contributes zero

retrieval_metrics.definition: nDCG@10 using binary relevance for candidates whose page is a Gold evidence page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: macro mean over cases with Gold pages

retrieval_metrics.definition: First 1-based five-preview batch containing a candidate on a Gold evidence page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: median and p90 over successful cases; separately report no-hit rate

retrieval_metrics.definition: Fraction of questions with a resolvable exact anchor for which the automatic exact read reaches the intended source or page.
retrieval_metrics.aggregation: successes divided by eligible exact-anchor cases

reading_metrics.definition: Number of explicit READ_SOURCE actions executed per case; automatic exact-anchor reads are reported separately.
Number of Environment-initiated exact-anchor reads per case; these are not Controller decisions.
Number of READ_ADJACENT_PAGE executions per case.
Number of confirmed or candidate relation navigation executions per case, also split by relation status.
reading_metrics.aggregation: mean and total by relation status and type

reading_metrics.definition: Number of retrieval-enrichment or full Visual Reader model calls per case, reported separately by purpose.
Fraction of executed actions that repeat the same normalized action and target without intervening state change.
reading_metrics.aggregation: duplicate executions divided by all executions

reading_metrics.definition: Fraction of cases ending incomplete because of STOP, budget exhaustion, timeout, execution failure, or unresolved gap.
reading_metrics.aggregation: macro rate with terminal reason breakdown

efficiency_metrics.definition: Total model input tokens per case, split by component.
Total model output tokens per case, split by component.
Measured GPU-active wall time per case and component.
End-to-end elapsed wall time per case.
Cost derived from measured resource time and the price table frozen in the experiment snapshot.
efficiency_metrics.aggregation: mean and total; always report the price-table source
